source: Author requested a regular workbench, Ironstone refinery, dust-to-Arc-Battery refinery and cooking station, October 15, 2026, and invited further camp station ideas. Additional stations and all construction tiers are proposals. Existing trial evidence: Docs/Evidence/Gameplay/CampWorkstations20261014/README.md and Docs/Evidence/Gameplay/CampIronstone20261014/README.md.
scope: Catalog only. No scene, world identity, terrain streaming, placed-object identity, unload/reload behavior or persisted runtime delta changes. Camp stations are placed facilities, not Legger crafting platforms. Existing firebox ID is retained as Cooking station rather than adding a duplicate heat station.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Placed camp facility; transport, assembly and footprint unresolved. The Legger is not a crafting platform.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed camp construction or specialist trade; construction recipe and availability unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Station function and candidate material families only. No station construction recipe, quantities, yield, power cost or production time established.
defaults.Supported behavior: Catalog proposal; station not implemented by this update.
defaults.Limitations: No wood, ordinary cloth, natural free water or plant feedstocks. Utilities, containment, process qualification and physical placement require design.
defaults.Open design decisions: Station footprint, construction, tool requirements, access, power, throughput and persistence remain unresolved.
defaults.Classification basis: Placed camp facility hosting a defined crafting operation; supporting hand tools, process vessels, upgrade parts and ingredients remain separate items.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 construction from craft-ready T1 stock. Construction tier is independent of the tier of products processed here; no construction recipe is approved.

items.name: Workbench
items.purpose: General camp work surface for fitting parts, assembling tools and repairing ordinary gear. The existing Camp Loop trial uses its workbench to craft an empty Arc Battery; this catalog entry does not expand the trial recipe roster.
items.icon: A worn metal worktop on a braced iron frame, with a vise and shallow shell parts tray; no wooden boards.

fields.Supported behavior: Workbench and empty-battery crafting are recorded in the CampWorkstations20261014 reference-trial receipt. This update creates only a catalog representation, not production placement or fresh runtime validation.
fields.Search aliases: regular workbench; assembly bench; repair bench; empty battery crafting

items.name: Ironstone refinery
items.purpose: Camp facility for breaking down and separating raw Ironstone Ore into coarse aggregate, iron-rich concentrate, mineral sand and mineral dust. Represents the existing manual Ironstone sorter; further refining or smelting would require separately designed operations.
items.icon: A low iron-framed sorting machine with a hopper, screened channels and separate ceramic output bins.

fields.Supported behavior: Manual sorting with a finite output tray is recorded in CampIronstone20261014. Catalog name adopts the author's Ironstone refinery label; runtime sorter naming and recipes remain unchanged.
fields.Limitations: Mineral dust is not Arc Dust and cannot charge Arc Batteries. Sorting does not produce refined metal automatically. No wood, natural free water or new smelting capability introduced.
fields.Search aliases: ironstone sorter; manual ironstone sorter; ore sorting; ore refinery

items.name: Dust refinery
items.purpose: Refine collected Arc Dust into Arc Energy and charge an existing empty Arc Battery. Accept a dust canister and an empty battery, retain the canister and unused dust, and return the same battery charged; dust alone does not create a battery casing.
items.icon: A ceramic-insulated metal apparatus with separate canister and battery sockets linked through a compact refining chamber.

fields.Supported behavior: Canister/battery docking and Arc-Dust charging are recorded in CampWorkstations20261014. Existing trial costs remain trial balance; this catalog entry adds no runtime service.
fields.Limitations: Requires collected Arc Dust and a compatible existing empty Arc Battery. Preserve battery and canister identity, leftover contents and energy accounting. Ordinary mineral dust is ineligible; no free battery holder or duplicated charge.
fields.Search aliases: arc dust refinery; arc battery charger; battery charging station

items.name: Salvage dismantling bench
items.purpose: Secure recovered scrap and damaged mechanisms for inspection and careful disassembly. Candidate outputs are sorted scrap and individually qualified reusable parts; dismantling does not guarantee repair or reproduce ancient technology.
items.icon: A scarred iron bench with restraint jaws, removable shell catch trays and a few dismantled metal housings.

fields.Search aliases: scrapping station; salvage inspection; dismantling table

items.name: Husk processing table
items.purpose: Hold shell husks and shed plates for scraping chitin/icore fibers and sorting useful shell pieces. Supplies candidate fiber feed for husk paper and later pressing; cheap raw shell does not imply cheap finished textiles.
items.icon: A shallow metal table with shell clamping jaws, a scraper rail and divided fiber collection trays.

fields.Search aliases: shell scraping station; icore extraction; chitin processing

items.name: Husk-fiber press
items.purpose: Press prepared husk-fiber feed into candidate paper sheets or difficult dense fiber stock using process-specific tooling. Paper and garment-grade material remain separate processes; pressing alone does not supply ordinary cloth or bypass costly textile preparation.
items.icon: An iron screw press with broad removable platens, a shallow ceramic forming tray and rough husk sheets.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 precision press assembly using T2 fitted screw, frame and platen parts. Output tier and difficult textile processing are separate questions.
fields.Search aliases: paper press; fiber pressing; pressed husk station

items.name: Ceramic forming bench
items.purpose: Prepare and shape qualified ceramic feed into unfired vessels, molds or fitted blanks before drying and kiln firing. Complements the existing firing kiln; binder chemistry, usable process liquids and feed suitability must be selected explicitly.
items.icon: A metal forming table with ceramic molds, shaping tools and an unfired vessel on a removable tray.

fields.Search aliases: pottery station; ceramic shaping; mold forming bench

items.name: Contained chemical processing station
items.purpose: Process separately contained faunal and mineral feedstocks into candidate industrial binders, sealants, lubricants or other processing agents. Select compatible vessels and a qualified process for each product; keep industrial chemicals separate from Phagia and food equipment.
items.icon: A bunded metal worktop with covered ceramic vessels, short fitted lines and sealed collection jars.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 station assembly from T2 containment and fitted process parts. No universal chemistry or process qualification implied.
fields.Search aliases: chemical workbench; sealant station; lubricant processing; binder preparation

items.name: Legger service stand
items.purpose: Support accessible Legger assemblies during inspection, cleaning, lubrication and replacement of compatible mechanical parts. Requires the Legger's physical presence and appropriate tools; service outcomes depend on parts and access rather than automatic full repair.
items.icon: A low braced metal service frame with adjustable support saddles and a side tool tray, sized beside a bipedal companion.

fields.Search aliases: legger repair station; companion service bay; mechanical maintenance stand

existingStationUpdate.name: Cooking station
existingStationUpdate.purpose: Camp food-preparation and cooking station combining the existing managed firebox concept with a preparation surface and compatible cooking vessels and tools. Process Phagia ingredients and selected edible fauna fractions into meals, bars or drinks using explicitly designed recipes; Phagia remains the nutritional foundation.
existingStationUpdate.aliases: managed cooking firebox; camp kitchen; food preparation station; phagia cooking
existingStationUpdate.limitations: Food contact must remain separate from industrial chemical processing. No ordinary combustion, free-water supply, wooden worktop, ordinary cloth or general fauna edibility assumed. Heat source, atmosphere management, food safety, quantities and benefits remain unresolved. Existing firebox item ID retained.
